DLMS-024.title: Smart PDF Review & Repair bulk selection
changes: Select All Visible respects the active All/Complete/Needs Review/Incomplete filter
Clear Selection clears record selection without altering record data
Question-bank review can mark all selected questions for deletion/exclusion or return them to Keep
Terminology review can exclude all selected terms or return them to Keep
Bulk actions update the existing per-record delete/exclude controls and therefore use the existing save path

DLMS-025.title: Editable Study Mode explanations in Edit Quiz
changes: Existing question explanations are loaded into Edit Quiz
Choice-question explanation field is placed directly below Add Answer Choices
Matching-question explanation field is placed below Add Pair
Edited explanations are saved to questions.explanation and included by the existing quiz JSON rebuild
